title: EnableCertificateManagement (off by default) needs an additional ACM + Route 53 IAM policy on the controller role

detection.reason: checked the controller Deployment's --feature-gates for EnableCertificateManagement=true — the opt-in that needs the extra policy

quote: If you enable the `EnableCertificateManagement` feature gate, attach the additional IAM policy for ACM and Route53 permissions to your controller's IAM role. See the documentation for details.
remediation: Only when enabling the gate: attach docs/install/iam_policy_acm_certs.json (acm:RequestCertificate / DeleteCertificate / AddTagsToCertificate / ListTagsForCertificate, acm-pca:IssueCertificate / GetCertificate / ListPermissions, route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets / ListHostedZones / ListHostedZonesByName) before Ingresses use alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/create-acm-cert.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.image? // "" | test("aws-load-balancer-controller")) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) \(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image) args=\(.spec.template.spec.containers[0].args // [] | join(" "))"'  # the controller Deployment, its image tag and every flag it runs with; SA=$(kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.image? // "" | test("aws-load-balancer-controller")) | "\(.metadata.namespace) \(.spec.template.spec.serviceAccountName)"' | head -1); ROLE=$(kubectl get sa -n ${SA% *} ${SA##* } -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations.eks\.amazonaws\.com/role-arn}'); aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn "$ROLE" --action-names acm:RequestCertificate route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets --query 'EvaluationResults[].[EvalActionName,EvalDecision]' --output text  # every row must read allowed; implicitDeny means the controller's IAM policy predates this release (Pod Identity: read the association's role with aws eks list-pod-identity-associations --cluster-name ... --namespace ... --service-account ...)

title: v3.3.0 repeats the vendor's apply-the-latest-CRDs note — no CRD schema changed between v3.2.0 and v3.3.0

detection.reason: nothing in the CRD files changed for this release (git diff v3.2.0..v3.3.0 over config/crd and helm crds is empty); the certificate-management feature is annotation-driven code; the hint names the LBC CRDs

quote: Action: Please apply the latest CRD definitions
remediation: No CRD change ships in 3.3.0 (ACM certificate management is driven by Ingress annotations). Re-applying the CRDs is harmless.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd ingressclassparams.elbv2.k8s.aws -o json | jq -r '[.spec.versions[] | select(.served) | .name] as $v | (.spec.versions[] | select(.storage) | .schema.openAPIV3Schema.properties.spec.properties // {} | keys) as $k | "served=\($v | join(",")) spec fields=\($k | join(","))"'  # the installed CRD schema; nothing new absent from the field list means the CRDs were not re-applied for this release
